question: Who operates the reported `openclawai.io/app/deploy` payment and deployment flow, and can this paid incident be routed privately to that operator?
rationale: Repository evidence establishes `clawhub.ai` as the ClawHub-operated service and contains no matching route, action, payment model, or historical implementation, but only a human with service ownership knowledge can safely resolve the account incident.

options.title: Route to service operator
options.body: Move the payment and deployment investigation to the operator of `openclawai.io`, request redaction of public account details, and post only a sanitized resolution here.

options.title: Establish ClawHub ownership
options.body: If the domain is an official ClawHub-operated alias or service, document that ownership and privately inspect the production request before creating a narrow recovery fix.

recommendation.title: Route to service operator
recommendation.body: Move the payment and deployment investigation to the operator of `openclawai.io`, request redaction of public account details, and post only a sanitized resolution here.
